az_bulges_the.blurb: The Bulges is a small trad crag in Queen Creek Canyon, tucked into the Torch section of The Refuge in Lower Devil's Canyon. Five trad routes are catalogued: two easy ones around 5.6 and three in the 5.10 range, so it suits a leader who wants moderate lines more than a hard testpiece. Quality is uneven, and most of the rock around the best line is on the poor side. Routes in this valley were put up mostly ground-up, with gear as the main protection, so bring a standard trad rack. You reach the base by taking the usual walk to the Torch and then bearing left.

az_post_book_left.blurb: Post Book Left is a five-route sport crag in the Promised Land section of the Prescott area, found past Valerie's on the left side. The routes run from an easy 5.8 through 5.10 and 5.11 up to two 5.12s, so most of the grade spread sits at the harder end, with a few lines overhanging and sustained. The neighbouring Post Book area is described as confusing, with many routes standing alone and hard to spot, so it helps to find Valerie's first and work down from there.

az_zone_tail_buttress.blurb: Zone-tail Buttress is a small quartzite crag in Isolation Canyon near Pine, Arizona, set a short way below the rim and north of the canyon's better-known walls. It holds five routes, three sport and two trad, ranging from one very easy line through a 5.7 to 5.8 middle to two at 5.10. The surrounding ground has a lot of loose rock, but the buttress itself is described as fairly solid, with room for more routes. Getting there takes some effort: follow cairns to the rim, then drop down a gully with scree and some downclimbing, roughly 100 yards from the rim.
